detail: CONVERGE-2 row 29 triage. The saved image runs with guard-checking-on t (host/native/io.lisp:9850 faults otherwise), so a host fnn-call of a guard-verified function checks its guard, and guard verification proves the guards of every guard-verified callee from it. premise_audit's docstring says 'the host does not verify guards' and so counts such conjuncts as unestablished. 44 of the 528 NEW premises appear in some :guard (candidate rows: fn-aec-physical-installationp, fn-aec-pool-statep, fn-aec-statep, fn-arpb-okp, fn-arpn-pendp, fn-arpn-pinsp, fn-bpn-sp-statep, fn-cat$p-wfp, fn-cp-nth, fn-dm-keyp, fn-dm-lanep, fn-gns-group-cursorp ...). Teeth needed both ways: a premise in the guard of a :program or :verify-guards nil subject stays a finding.
fix: premise_audit: a premise R of theorem T is GUARD-ESTABLISHED when R is a conjunct of the guard of T's subject, the subject is guard-verified (world dump: coverage.py, not text), and every host path to it enters through a guard-verified function; report it as its own class, not a finding. Red-before/green-after fixture tests for verified, :program and :verify-guards nil subjects.
title: premise_audit model gap: a premise that is a conjunct of a guard-verified subject's guard is established at the host entry
